messages.content: 今天美國的黃金價格是多少？

function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

Face_Value.description: The face value of the bond. This is a float type value.

Coupon_rate.description: The coupon rate of the bond. This is a float type value.

Required_return.description: The required rate of return on the bond. This is a float type value.

maturity_years.description: The number of years to maturity of the bond.

message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。一般來說，黃金價格會在每個交易日的不同時間波動，並且受多種因素影響（如美元走勢、通脹預期、地緣政治風險等）。如果您需要最準確的即時價格，建議查看以下來源：

| 資料來源 | 連結 |
|----------|------|
| Bloomberg 金價行情 | https://www.bloomberg.com/quote/GC%3ACommodities |
| Reuters 金價行情 | https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities |
| Kitco 金價行情 | https://www.kitco.com/ |

這些網站通常會提供「即時」或「延遲 15 分鐘」的黃金價格，並且會顯示每盎司（troy ounce）的美元價格。若您想要更精確的數字，請直接前往上述網站或使用金融資訊服務（如 Bloomberg Terminal、Reuters Eikon 等）。
message.reasoning: User asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" They want today's gold price in US. We need to provide current price. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. We can provide typical price or say we can't fetch. We can mention typical price around $2000 per ounce. But we should be careful. We can say we don't have real-time data. Provide approximate.
